description: llama.cpp fork serving natlang's native models: native state spans (consume), native state production (producer adapter and capture) and the native-state protocol (/v1/neuralese/info, /v1/neuralese/native-states), decision readout (/v1/natlang/score), guided generation (guidance) and per-sequence LoRA in llama-server; parity dumps in tools/neuralese. A separate git checkout, not vendored. The browser's wllama is built from this branch.
build_cpu: cmake -S . -B build-cpu && cmake --build build-cpu --target llama-server llama-state-span-dump llama-logits-dump -j16
build_cuda: cmake -S . -B build-cuda -DGGML_CUDA=ON && cmake --build build-cuda --target llama-server llama-state-span-dump -j16
parity: scripts/neuralese_data/check_llama_producer_parity.py (native state production against the native engine)
scripts/neuralese_data/check_tuned_lora_llama_parity.py (tuned LoRA against the native adapted model)
scripts/neuralese_data/check_llama_native_state_protocol.py (llama-server native-state protocol: store, consumption receipts, production, exact reference encoding)
